subject: Staggered tranche onboarding plan for Dedicated GPUs - Luminate Health
messages:
From: Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@luminatehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@luminatehealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity follow-up and next steps

Ben —

Thanks for the check-in. We finished our August/September evaluation and saw a sustained 45% increase in p99 inference volume for our core triage model. The existing dedicated pool is hitting high utilization windows (especially 10:00–16:00 PT) and we’re concerned about tail latency for production triage.

We have budget approval to expand capacity but procurement needs a clear onboarding schedule and cost phasing (Q4 vs Q1). Can Redwood provide a plan that avoids a big up-front tranche but guarantees runway for Black Friday and an upcoming pilot in January?

Also attaching the usage CSV you requested.

—Sofia
Sofia Ramirez
Head of ML Ops, Luminate Health
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@luminatehealth.com>
Cc: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@luminatehealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity follow-up and next steps

Sofia — thanks for the data and context. I reviewed the attached CSV quickly and copied Monica (CS) to help with utilization analysis. Two quick thoughts:

- We can support a staggered onboarding of GPUs in 2 tranches (60% now, remainder early Q1) to smooth cost recognition while ensuring capacity during peak windows.
- We’ll propose a cooling policy and KV prefix caching changes to reduce p99 during peak without immediately doubling hardware.

I'll draft a formal staged plan and estimated bill-of-materials + cost phasing. Monica, can you take the usage and produce a utilization-normalized GPU estimate?

Action: Ben to circulate staged plan by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T11:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity follow-up and next steps (analysis attached)

Ben / team —

Attached is a quick utilization-normalized estimate from Sofia's CSV (usage_report_sep2026.csv). Key points:

- Observed average GPU utilization across production windows: 68% (std dev 9%)
- Peak-day p95 token throughput implies need for +22 GPUs to restore p99 latency to target under current scheduling.
- With KV prefix caching + batching optimizations (config changes only), we estimate a 12–14 GPU effective saving during peak (so net +8–10 GPUs needed).

Recommendation: Staged tranches — add 10 GPUs on Nov 1 (to cover Q4 peaks) and an additional 8 on Jan 10 if January pilot usage validates growth. This gives procurement a two-line charge and mitigates overcommit.

Attachments: staged_onboarding_plan_v1.pdf, usage_report_sep2026.csv

Monica Patel
Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@luminatehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Staged onboarding plan + cost phasing (proposal)

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for the quick turnaround. Please find the proposed staged onboarding plan attached (PDF). TL;DR:

1) Nov 1: Provision 10 dedicated GPUs (preferred A100 80GB equivalent). This covers anticipated Q4 peaks.
2) Jan 10: Provision additional 8 GPUs if pilot rollout on Jan 1 shows >=30% traffic lift.
3) Billing: Nov tranche billed pro-rata starting Nov 1 (monthly commit), Jan tranche billed when provisioned.
4) Fallback: If we see higher-than-estimated growth before Jan, we have a hot-burst policy to spin up on-demand capacity for up to 72 hours while we finalize tranche 2.

We included an optional 12-month commit adder with a 10% discount if you prefer to convert both tranches into a single annual commit.

Files: staged_onboarding_plan_v1.pdf, redwood-commit-term-sheet-lh.pdf

Would love your thoughts and any procurement constraints.

Best,
Ben
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@luminatehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@luminatehealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staged onboarding plan + cost phasing (proposal)

Ben / Sofia —

Appreciate the clear plan. Procurement wants the following before they sign off: a short teardown that shows cost delta between staged vs single-commit pricing, a clause for early termination if our pilot stalls, and an SLA addendum for p99 latency during Black Friday weekend. Can you provide those?

Also, can you confirm the lead time to provision tranche 1 once procurement approves?

—Ethan
Ethan Cole
Director, Platform Engineering, Luminate Health
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@luminatehealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staged onboarding plan + cost phasing (proposal)

Ethan —

Quick answers:

- Cost delta doc: attached (high level) and a line-item monthly comparison in the Drive link. Staged is ~18% higher than single-commit over 12 months, but lowers immediate cash flow.
- Early termination: we can include a 60-day notice termination carve-out for tranche 2 (with a small conversion fee).
- SLA addendum: Markus, can you confirm p99 Black Friday weekend SLOs and any recommended fallback model variants?

Provisioning lead time: Once PO is received we can provision tranche 1 within 7 business days for dedicated capacity (we keep a short warm pool for committed customers). For hot-burst on-demand we can enable within hours but with no commit discount.

Laura Bennett
Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
